current_f2_facts: VoiceOutputPacket is commit_eligible only when playback_state=completed and heard_fraction=1.0.
Interrupted output may preserve a nonzero heard_fraction while remaining non-commit-eligible.
Current cited F2 packet source does not explicitly define whether the exactly-heard prefix of an interrupted response belongs in ephemeral next-turn model context.

pinned_upstream.relevant_fact: The pinned local Realtime surface supports response.cancel and conversation.item.truncate, while cancellation/rollback semantics can differ from exact heard-boundary context retention.

external_reference_convergence: Current LiveKit interruption handling truncates conversation history to the portion of agent speech actually heard.
Current RealtimeSession interfaces expose message truncation at audioEndMs for playback-synchronized history.
policy_question: For an interrupted assistant response with 0 < heard_fraction < 1, what exact assistant semantics may influence the next local model turn?

recommended_policy_candidate.rule: The exactly measured/heard assistant prefix may remain in ephemeral next-turn dialogue context; the unheard tail must be excluded. The interrupted response remains non-commit-eligible for durable VoiceOutcome/memory/effect authority unless independently admitted.
why: preserves conversational continuity for words the user actually heard
keeps unheard semantics from influencing later turns
preserves the existing F2 durable commit/effect boundary
matches current interruption-history practice in mature realtime voice frameworks

counterpolicy.risk: The next turn may exhibit conversational amnesia for speech the user demonstrably heard.

authority_separation.VoiceOutcome_commit: unchanged, fully-heard completed output only under current contract

required_trigger4_action.first: Pin one explicit interrupted-response next-turn context policy in the appropriate existing F2 voice contract/authority surface without reopening accepted WP715 packet runtime scope.
required_trigger4_action.then: Execute the existing HF09/HF10/HF02-HF05 runtime lane through the already-proven controller -> vps-clay-host path; do not create a duplicate semantic lane.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 pins the interrupted-response ephemeral-context policy, then executes the already-existing HF protocol lane once through the proven controller/VPS route and classifies exact measured behavior against that policy.
